onboarding.roleBody: Select how you will use the Buildink marketplace.

errors.profileType: Choose an account type to continue.

roles.individualBody: Browse, save and contact marketplace members with a personal profile.
roles.workerBody: Present your trade, skills, certificates and availability to employers.
roles.contractorBody: Discover opportunities, submit proposals and present contractor services.
roles.supplierContactBody: Represent a supplier organization and manage its catalog and enquiries.
roles.serviceProviderBody: Offer specialized services, certifications and reference work. Create, join or claim a company when you represent an organization.
roles.companyBody: Represent a construction company. Create, join or claim an organization and manage its marketplace presence.
roles.projectOwnerBody: Publish projects, review proposals and hire marketplace professionals as a client or project owner.
roles.subcontractorBody: Offer trade services, associate with a company and bid on project opportunities.
